pedal: Boss DD-8 Digital Delay — the loop: what limits it, what it does at high Feedback, mode by mode (mono: Output A)
note: FEEDBACK fully clockwise (5:00), MODE to STANDARD. One burst, then 16 s of the pedal repeating it. Before the take the pedal must be silent: FEEDBACK to 7:00 until it is, then back to 5:00 (both are end stops).
